method.repo_scores: H, B, O on 1-5 and D in {0,1}; judgement-based heuristic, not measured; composite = 0.5H + 0.25B + 0.25O - D

per_usd_reading.base_case: Deterministic base efficiency is identical at every cap (demand is fully covered from $77): C01 0.2024, C03 0.2004, C13 0.1911 M outcome tokens per USD (unemployed).
per_usd_reading.expected: Monte Carlo expected efficiency rises with cap and flattens. C01 peaks at $99 (unemployed) and $106 (employed); C03 rises to $106.
per_usd_reading.best_value_cap: $92: C03 reaches 98.1% (unemployed) and 98.5% (employed) of its $106 expected efficiency; gains above $92 are within ~1-2%.
per_usd_reading.noise_note: Differences under about 1% sit inside the Monte Carlo noise (relative half-width 0.5-1.4%).

statistics.anova_reading: Significant but small: eta^2 = 0.014. p-values are inflated by n = 3000 per group. Levene p = 1.4e-4, so Kruskal-Wallis is the primary test; it agrees (p = 2.6e-25).
statistics.regression_reading: OLS R2 0.889. Quadratic preferred by 5-fold CV (RMSE 0.0087 vs 0.0137 linear). Residuals are heteroscedastic (Breusch-Pagan p = 4e-90) and non-normal (Shapiro-Wilk W = 0.976, p = 2.6e-22), so the t-tests describe the simulation only; bootstrap CIs and rank tests carry the inference.
statistics.qre_note: Logit QRE on grade/8 over the three finalists. Shares at lambda = 5, 16, 50 are reported; C03 dominates as rationality rises.

flip_threshold.interpretation: Lean routing (p=0.23) beats the audit baseline (p=0.30) when R0 is below this value; above it the 30% premium share is needed for verification.

statistics.error_margin: Monte Carlo relative half-width 0.5-1.4% (finalists 0.7-0.8%), inside the 1-3% target.

before_after_parameters_unemployed_85.improved: Yes on expected efficiency, coverage, spend and max regret. R0 is still unmeasured (assumed 0.30). C01 has higher expected efficiency than C03 (+2.9%).
